routes.label: Pair the even and odd terms

question: The sum of the first eighty positive odd integers subtracted from the sum of the first eighty positive even integers is
solution:
Each positive even integer is one greater than the corresponding positive odd integer. Subtracting the odd sum from the even sum and grouping corresponding terms gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
&(2+4+\cdots+160)-(1+3+\cdots+159)\\
&\qquad=(2-1)+(4-3)+\cdots+(160-159).
\end{aligned}
\]
Every term from each sum appears in exactly one of these \(80\) pairs, and each pair equals \(1\). The difference is therefore \(80\cdot1=\boxed{80}\), choice E.
